This holds within the scope of a declared outage."},{"id":"bank-change-P02","label":"contradicted","source_units":["B05","B01"],"rationale":"B05 states that the outage procedure does not authorise use of new unverified bank details. B01 makes a change usable only after Treasury verification."},{"id":"bank-change-P03","label":"contradicted","source_units":["B02","B01"],"rationale":"B02 says the entering operator must not approve that change. B01 requires approval by a person who did not enter the change."},{"id":"bank-change-P04","label":"contradicted","source_units":["B03","B01"],"rationale":"B03 says email confirmation alone is insufficient for Treasury verification. B01 requires Treasury verification and independent approval before a change is usable, so email alone cannot make it usable."},{"id":"bank-change-P05","label":"supported","source_units":["B01"],"rationale":"B01 explicitly requires both Treasury verification and independent approval before a change becomes usable."},{"id":"bank-change-P06","label":"not_established","source_units":["B06"],"rationale":"B06 states that the documents define no tenure requirement for either role. The claimed three-year requirement therefore has no support. Because this silence is not an explicit prohibition, the label is not_established rather than contradicted."},{"id":"bank-change-P07","label":"not_established","source_units":["B06"],"rationale":"B06 describes the log as recording the operator ID and approver ID, but it does not frame this as an obligation. The 'must' in the proposition is therefore not established."},{"id":"bank-change-P08","label":"not_established","source_units":["B04"],"rationale":"B04 grants a permission ('may'), not an obligation. No source makes such a payment mandatory, but no source excludes a duty either, so the proposition is left open."}]}

reasoning_details.text:
I'm checking each of the four claims against the sources. P01 is supported by B04, which covers the declared outage and its scope. P02 looks contradicted: B05 says the outage procedure doesn't authorise unverified new details, and B01 says a change is usable only after verification, so both B01 and B05 cut against it. P03 is contradicted by B02, and P04 is contradicted by B03 and B01, since an email alone doesn't count as verification.

I'm now going through P05 through P08. P05 is supported by B01. P06 and P07 aren't established by the sources: B06 says the documents don't define a tenure requirement, and it describes the operator and approver IDs without stating an obligation. P08 is also not established, since B04's "may" grants permission and doesn't contradict a mandatory rule.
